briefdescription.para: Installs an asynchronous callback function for the given HandlerType.

para.preformatted: HandlerType Callback Function Type ----------------------- -------------------------------------------------- XMAILBOX_RECV_HANDLER Recv handler XMAILBOX_ERROR_HANDLER Error handler

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when the handler is installed.

simplesect.para: Invoking this function for a handler that has already been installed replaces it with the new handler.
